public.text: Mandatory or optional support is recorded as a property on the serving relationship or as a Constraint. Using two alternative modelling methods may produce inconsistent national models and automated checks.
public.suggestedRevision: Select one normative representation for support obligation. Prefer a formal Constraint or defined relationship property with a controlled vocabulary and machine-readable validation rule.
